source.title: Elevated errors on claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com
source.author: __vivek

excerpt.zh: Claude 服务故障影响 claude.ai、Claude Code、Claude Console 和 Claude Cowork。官方称已部署修复并解决问题，但未公布故障原因或受影响范围的细节。
excerpt.en: The Claude outage affected claude.ai, Claude Code, Claude Console, and Claude Cowork. Anthropic says the issue was resolved, but has not detailed its cause or scope.

disclosure.en: This article was automatically generated by the Weekly Day AI gateway model using content from Hacker News.

text.zh: Claude 服务故障于 2026 年 11 月 13 日影响多个产品。Claude 状态页称，用户在 claude.ai 和 Claude Code 登录时遇到问题，Claude Console（platform.claude.com）与 Claude Cowork 也被列为受影响服务。
text.en: A Claude outage affected several products on Nov. 13, 2026. Claude's status page said users had trouble authenticating to claude.ai and Claude Code; Claude Console (platform.claude.com) and Claude Cowork were also listed as affected.

text.zh: Claude 故障从调查到解决
官方状态记录显示，调查于 09:58 UTC 开始。到 11:05 UTC，团队表示已部署修复并正在监控恢复情况；11:58 UTC，状态更新为已解决。记录没有说明具体根因，也没有给出故障期间错误率或受影响用户数量。
text.en: The status log says the investigation began at 09:58 UTC. At 11:05 UTC, the team reported that a fix had been deployed and recovery was being monitored. By 11:58 UTC, the incident was marked resolved. The report does not identify the underlying cause or quantify error rates or affected users.

text.zh: Claude 服务状态仍需持续关注
text.en: What the Claude service status tells users

text.zh: 这次事件同时触及聊天、开发工具和平台控制台的认证，可能打断个人使用与依赖 Claude 的开发工作流。状态页确认问题已解决，但没有进一步说明各产品恢复是否同步，也未披露预防复发的措施。对用户而言，官方状态页是核实服务恢复情况的直接来源；若仍遇到登录错误，现有通报不足以判断问题是否与该事件有关。
text.en: Because authentication issues touched the chat service, developer tools, and platform console, the incident could interrupt both individual use and development workflows that rely on Claude. The status page confirms resolution, but does not say whether all products recovered at the same time or describe steps to prevent a recurrence. For users, the official status page is the direct source for checking service recovery. If login errors persist, the available report is not detailed enough to determine whether they are related to this incident.
